name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires the box to be back in your hands on the very next step, but the task says to pick it up again on your very next move. A move is not necessarily the next step. Use Response(box_fell, holding_box) to require pickup on that move or later.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires picking the box up again on the very next move after each fall, but Response(box_fell, holding_box) allows any later step. Replace it with hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box).

CHANGES REQUIRED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) does not match “pick it up again on your very next move.” It requires holding_box on the step immediately after the fall, but holding_box is a lasting condition, not the pickup event, so it can be satisfied by already carrying the box. The task requires a new pickup on that next move; use an event proposition for picking up the box, or otherwise ensure the clause tracks that action.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` requires the box to be held on the very next step after it falls. The task requires picking it up on the very next move; that pickup makes `holding_box` true only after the step’s events, so it cannot satisfy this clause. Use a next-step requirement for the pickup event, but no such proposition is declared. The current clause cannot express the requested action.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box there, and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up again on the very next step after a fall.

texts: Reach the exit carrying the box.
Carry the box when you reach the exit.
If the box falls, be carrying it again on the very next step.
